descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · S07b The hidden Rounding Sheet can be turned back on (flag on)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T3 Quick Dictation is the pad only: the separate Rounding Sheet view (patients with open tasks, today's assigned compartments, 'Needs patient') is hidden, not deleted, so it can be turned back on. (TFA-92583 AC 5; TFA-92583 AC 4; TFA-92583 AC 1)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given A second build of the same commit with VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET=true

When Run the four tests in the 'Rounding Sheet' describe of e2e/quick-dictation.spec.ts on that build

Then The sheet renders again with today's patients and its compartments, and stays out of Nursing Home

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): All four 'Rounding Sheet' tests pass with the flag on (T3, 'so it can be turned back on'). Whether a build flag counts as 'can be turned back on' is Q8. No verdict until the flag-on stack exists

Where it ran: local newspec-b (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (blocked)

S07b is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-04.matrix.json; a letter suffix = one case split in several), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-b.

Test method: PW · Playwright script — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-b.

UAT item: TC-04 Quick Dictation (Hospital only; TC-05 Rounding Sheet merged in) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-04/S07b

The hidden Rounding Sheet can be turned back on (flag on)

Tickets: TFA-92583 Rounding Sheet (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-b: status passed in newspec-b/results.json → passed (passed).

How it is tested (newspec-b/plan.json, automatable: yes): Start a second Vite (flag-on build of the same commit, VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET=true) on localhost:6481 with its own cacheDir, pointed at the same local Convex 4510; run a qa-agent port of the four 'Rounding Sheet' tests (same bodies as e2e/quick-dictation.spec.ts) on a fresh account per test against 6481. Q8 (does a build flag count as 'can be turned back on') recorded, not decided. — Only needs a second local web build; the backend and data are the local stack.

Detail:

Flag-on build of the same commit (VITE_SHOW_ROUNDING_SHEET=true, Vite on localhost:6481, own cacheDir, same local backend; build serves the flag as "true"). The four 'Rounding Sheet' tests from e2e/quick-dictation.spec.ts, ported unchanged except for a fresh account per test, all pass: sheet under today's date with open/ticked task, words added after placement flagged then placed alone, three patients + one unclear piece with no model call, sheet absent in Nursing Home. Record-only (Q8): it comes back only through a rebuild with a build-time flag, not a runtime switch.

Evidence: 3 attached.
